item.title: EBSA enforcement efforts yield $1.4 billion in recoveries
item.description: EBSA said the $1.4 billion returned to plans, participants and beneficiaries represents a slight increase from the $1.384 billion recovered in fiscal year 2024. The post EBSA enforcement efforts yield $1.4 billion in recoveries appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The HR–IT debate in the age of AI: cooperation or consolidation?
item.description: Despite predictions about a growing demand for a chief productivity officer, this expert suggest businesses focus instead on outcomes, not org charts. The post The HR–IT debate in the age of AI: cooperation or consolidation? appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: How HR leaders can turn pharmacy transparency into real leverage
item.description: If employers hold the purse strings, why don't they push harder for transparency and better terms? Here's why in part two of our series. The post How HR leaders can turn pharmacy transparency into real leverage appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: How Oracle’s $50 billion infrastructure play might benefit HR teams
item.description: Oracle plans to raise $45–$50 billion in 2026 to expand Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and meet growing customer demand. What can HCM clients expect? The post How Oracle’s $50 billion infrastructure play might benefit HR teams appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Cigna to lay off about 2,000 employees and offer voluntary separations
item.description: Employees say managers told them last week that the company plans to eliminate about 3% of positions by the end of February. The post Cigna to lay off about 2,000 employees and offer voluntary separations appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: $15K to land a job? What HR can make of ‘reverse recruiting’
item.description: A growing industry charges job seekers thousands to navigate corporate hiring. For HR leaders, the trend is a signal worth examining. The post $15K to land a job? What HR can make of ‘reverse recruiting’ appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Legal and compliance readiness plunges amid growing regulatory and cyber threats
item.description: Employer confidence in addressing litigation risk is trending downward, as threats including cybersecurity and disability accommodations are on the rise. The post Legal and compliance readiness plunges amid growing regulatory and cyber threats appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The hidden risks of AI-driven layoffs
item.description: To reduce the risk of legal, compliance and reputational risk, this expert says, use AI as a decision-support—not decision-making—tool for layoff planning. The post The hidden risks of AI-driven layoffs appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Why one expert calls FTC’s Express Scripts settlement a missed opportunity
item.description: "My initial response to the FTC PBM settlements. meh," Mark Cuban posted recently on LinkedIn regarding the Express Scripts deal. The post Why one expert calls FTC’s Express Scripts settlement a missed opportunity appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Trump’s anti-DEI efforts: 4 big updates
item.description: One year after the Trump administration moved to dismantle private and public DEI efforts, ongoing legal challenges suggest uncertainty remains. The post Trump’s anti-DEI efforts: 4 big updates appeared first on HR Executive.
